messages:
Tara (AE): Quick thread for Orpheon POC. They need SAML SSO, SCIM users+groups, RBAC mapping, domain proofing, and a Dedicated vs Private price comparison. Also asked about bulk import options and a short SLA for auth handoff. Need reply by EOD Fri. Any red flags?

Ben (SE): SAML: request IdP metadata XML, desired NameID format, and whether they need encrypted assertions. Group attribute could be 'groups' or 'memberOf' - ask them. We support IdP & SP-init flows.

Noor (Security): Security checklist items from questionnaire: RSA-SHA256 signatures, SCIM over TLS1.2+, SCIM auth via client_credentials with scoped tokens (rotate 90 days), audit logs 180d. Also they asked for recent pen test summary and SOC2 attestation. Legal will require those for Private.

Hugo (Eng): SCIM: support full + delta sync. They asked about SFTP CSV import for initial bulk onboarding instead of SCIM  we have a secure SFTP ingest option that maps externalId -> user. Note: SFTP imports do not auto-create group memberships unless mapping provided. Default SCIM rate-limit is 50 req/min; we can raise for Dedicated POC. For group->role mapping we use group.displayName by default but can map via group.type or custom attribute. Example SCIM user we accept: { "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "userName": "alex@orpheon.com", "externalId": "orp-42" }

Priya (Billing): For pricing I'll prepare a short side-by-side. Need MAU and expected tokens/mo. We can offer a 30-day POC credit and a committed-token discount for Dedicated. What numbers do we have?

Tara (AE): Customer estimate: 420 MAUs for POC, ~1.6M tokens/mo, ~600 groups. They may scale to 2k MAUs later. They also asked if tenant-proofing can use an MX record as alternative to TXT.

Ben (SE): We can accept DNS TXT or a signed email from an admin. MX token is non-standard but we can support it for the POC if they prefer; will document the exact token format.

InfraBot: scim-ingest/2026-03-01 deployed to staging  SFTP import smoke tests passed \u2705

Noor (Security): Potential blocker: Orpheon says EU-only for identity data. If confirmed we need EU Dedicated or EU Private and DPA + region addendum. Also Legal wants a short note on least-privilege SCIM scopes (scim:users.write scim:groups.write) and token rotation cadence.

Hugo (Eng): Private install checklist (short): allowlist outbound control-plane 443, exchange mTLS certs, provide admin contact for upgrade windows. We'll include SFTP endpoint details and RBAC mapping template.

Priya (Billing): I'll draft the quote with POC credit and Dedicated vs Private comparison. Need final MAU/token numbers by tomorrow noon to lock rates.

Tara (AE): Great  I'll request IdP metadata, sample SAML response, confirmation on EU residency, and if they want SFTP for bulk import. Scheduling customer sync for Wed 9am PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
